fusions.name: Beaked Prow
fusions.desc: Rams the target for 30 damage that ignores armour, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Shields Along the Rail
fusions.desc: Slams a wall of shields through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 13 damage to everything in it and stunning each enemy for 1 second.

fusions.name: Double Hull
fusions.desc: Absorbs the next 26 damage you take, for up to 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds, and you move 12% faster for the first 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Copper Sheathing
fusions.desc: Every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, you move 4% faster, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
